1: """
2: Codebase seed — Minimal Express Todo API (tier 1, good seams)
3: 
4: A single-file Express app with clean structure: models, routes, error handling.
5: Designed as a baseline for multi-session TypeScript stories.
6: """
7: 
8: import express, { Request, Response } from 'express';
9: import sqlite3 from 'better-sqlite3';
10: 
11: const app = express();
12: app.use(express.json());
13: 
14: const DATABASE = process.env.DATABASE || 'todos.db';
15: const db = sqlite3(DATABASE);
16: 
17: db.exec(`
18:   CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tasks (
19:     id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
20:     title TEXT NOT NULL,
21:     status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
22:     created_at TEXT NOT NULL
23:   )
24: `);
25: 
26: // ── Models ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
27: 
28: interface Task {
29:   id: number;
30:   title: string;
31:   status: string;
32:   created_at: string;
33: }
34: 
35: function createTask(title: string): Task {
36:   const now = new Date().toISOString();
37:   const stmt = db.prepare(
38:     "INSERT INTO tasks (title, status, created_at) VALUES (?, 'pending', ?)"
39:   );
40:   const result = stmt.run(title, now);
41:   return { id: result.lastInsertRowid as number, title, status: 'pending', created_at: now };
42: }
43: 
44: function getTasks(): Task[] {
45:   return db.prepare("SELECT * FROM tasks ORDER BY created_at DESC").all() as Task[];
46: }
47: 
48: function getTask(id: number): Task | undefined {
49:   return db.prepare("SELECT * FROM tasks WHERE id = ?").get(id) as Task | undefined;
50: }
51: 
52: function updateTask(id: number, fields: { title?: string; status?: string }): Task | undefined {
53:   const task = getTask(id);
54:   if (!task) return undefined;
55:   const updates: string[] = [];
56:   const params: (string | number)[] = [];
57:   if (fields.title !== undefined) { updates.push("title = ?"); params.push(fields.title); }
58:   if (fields.status !== undefined) { updates.push("status = ?"); params.push(fields.status); }
59:   if (updates.length > 0) {
60:     params.push(id);
61:     db.prepare(`UPDATE tasks SET ${updates.join(', ')} WHERE id = ?`).run(...params);
62:   }
63:   return getTask(id);
64: }
65: 
66: // ── Routes ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
67: 
68: app.get('/tasks', (_req: Request, res: Response) => {
69:   res.json(getTasks());
70: });
71: 
72: app.post('/tasks', (req: Request, res: Response) => {
73:   const title = (req.body?.title || '').trim();
74:   if (!title) return res.status(400).json({ error: 'title is required' });
75:   res.status(201).json(createTask(title));
76: });
77: 
78: app.get('/tasks/:id', (req: Request, res: Response) => {
79:   const task = getTask(Number(req.params.id));
80:   if (!task) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'task not found' });
81:   res.json(task);
82: });
83: 
84: app.put('/tasks/:id', (req: Request, res: Response) => {
85:   const task = updateTask(Number(req.params.id), {
86:     title: req.body?.title,
87:     status: req.body?.status,
88:   });
89:   if (!task) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'task not found' });
90:   res.json(task);
91: });
92: 
93: export default app;

part.text:
Done. Added template engine + layout support while keeping existing functionality intact.

**Changes:**
- `src/templates.ts` (new) — Handlebars (`.hbs`) and EJS (`.ejs`) engines; `loadTemplates()` reads `./templates/`, `./templates/layouts/`, `./templates/partials/`; `renderTemplateFile()` renders with per-render Handlebars partials and EJS `include()` (filename-relative), normalizing the `{{{body}}}` placeholder for EJS.
- `src/ssg.ts` — `Page` gains `data`, `template`, `layout` from frontmatter; `build(contentDir, outputDir, templatesDir)` uses templates when present, else falls back to legacy `renderPage`/`renderIndex`; added `renderPageWithTemplates()` (page template → default/named layout with `{{{body}}}`) and `renderIndexWithTemplates()` (`index` template).
- `src/cli.ts` — new `--templates <dir>` option.
- `tests/templates.test.ts` (new) — template/layout/partial loading, per-page template & layout via frontmatter, missing template/layout errors, Handlebars + EJS full builds, index template, legacy fallback.
- `tests/cli.test.ts` — `--templates` parsing/usage and a templated `run` build.

`tsc` builds cleanly and all 42 tests pass.
